```yaml
    report both intercepts + their F_2-axis FI difference K_csub_F2_diff = |Mellin - zeta|.
```

## §W7-3. S93-W7-3-FOLD-ENERGY-WINDOWED-DS-GATE

```yaml
# ---- Identity ----
gate_id: "S93-W7-3-FOLD-ENERGY-WINDOWED-DS-GATE"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[SIGN]"   # the windowed d_s monotone-vs-plateau DIRECTION + the gamma_E DOS-exponent are directional discriminators; 3-tuple companion row REQUIRED
classification: "GEOMETRIC"   # d_s(sigma) is a heat-trace functional of the D_K spectrum on the SU(3) fiber; the question is the fabric's intermediate-window spectral dimension, not a phonon excitation
agent_type: "kaluza-klein-theorist + landau-condensed-matter-theorist"   # two-sided d_s: kk (monotone-to-8 / Weyl) vs landau (van-Hove plateau / flat-band)

method:
  description: |
    Compute the windowed spectral dimension on the converged-L_max D_K spectrum at tau_fold = 0.190,
    NORMAL STATE (Delta = 0; the BdG gap is NOT applied — this is the bare D_K heat trace):
      P(sigma) = Sum_{(p,q)} dim(p,q) * Sum_i exp(-sigma * lambda_i^2)   [return probability / heat trace]
      d_s(sigma) = -2 d ln P(sigma) / d ln sigma                          [log-log windowed slope]
    on sigma in [0.5, 2.0] M_KK^-2, with the fold-match diffusion window sigma_* = 1/E_B2^2 =
    1/0.845269087679269^2 = 1.40051 (a derived window pin, tagged # (local) in the script; brackets the
    d_s=2 bulk crossing near sigma ~ 0.42 and the gap-onset near sigma ~ 1.49). Evaluate d_s via a
    centered finite-difference of ln P vs ln sigma on a fine sigma grid (>= 40 points across the window).

    PLUS the direct energy-axis DOS-exponent fit (the mechanism verdict, INDEPENDENT of the min-d_s band):
    extract gamma_E from the cumulative count
      N(lambda) - N(E_0) ~ sign(lambda - E_0) * |lambda - E_0|^{1 - gamma_E}   near E_0 = E_B2 = 0.845269087679269,
    fit window w_fit = (E_B2 - E_B1) = 0.026 M_KK, robustness re-fit at 2*w_fit. gamma_E is the
    directly-fitted DOS exponent (cumulative-count estimator), the discriminating sub-quantity per
    AH-PF-1 (cross-pillar-bridge-corpus.md §24 / cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §"Diffusion-window-
    observable specialization").

    FAIR-COMPARISON OBSERVABLE DISCIPLINE (AH-PF-1 / phononic-framing.md §"Same-functional-different-
    scale fair-comparison"): the WINDOWED d_s(sigma_*) is a DISTINCT functional of P(sigma) from the
    settled sigma->0 Weyl asymptotic d_s(sigma->0) = dim(SU(3)) = 8. This gate computes ONLY the
    intermediate-window observable; it does NOT assert anything about the sigma->0 asymptotic and does
    NOT conflate the two. The (observable, diffusion-window) pair is fixed at the intermediate window
    sigma_* on the substrate side; no summand-matching, no CDT cross-comparison (the S53 d_s_max=67.829
    3D-K^2-weighting artifact + L_max>>6 caution make any NUMERICAL CDT comparison premature, Claim B).

    Z=1/pi CONSISTENCY CHECK (NOT a gate): compute Z = rho_E * v_g and verify Z ~ 1/pi off-fold across
    the gamma_E in [1/2,1) family (the PROVEN WALL is a product invariant for the whole family, Sage-
    verified; Z is const for all gamma_E and is NOT a gamma_E-lock — D-L1). Report Z as a corroborant only.

    L_max-convergence: evaluate at the canonical L_max=12 master cache AND at L_max-2=10 (filter the
    master cache to p+q<=10); report both d_s(sigma_*) and gamma_E at both L_max plus the two-point
    deltas. Per math-scripts.md Casimir-bound/Friedrich-Bar feasibility: the B2 fold sits near the
    spectral bottom, well below the operative |lambda| ceiling, so a modest converged L_max is feasible
    on the block-diagonal cache without full reconstruction (largest single block at L_max=15 is dim
    9792, dense 1.53 GB, fits VRAM). Report L_max_operational vs L_max_plan.
  producing_script: "computations/_shared/s93_w7_3_fold_energy_windowed_ds.py"

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "set"   # two-sided classification {Reading-KK, Reading-van-Hove, INDETERMINATE} on the (min d_s, monotonicity, gamma_E) joint criterion
  form: "Reading-KK iff (min_{sigma in [0.5,2.0]} d_s(sigma) > 5) AND (d_s strictly monotone) AND (gamma_E in [0.5,0.6]); Reading-van-Hove iff (min d_s < 3) AND (flat sub-window d(d_s)/d ln sigma ~ 0) AND (gamma_E in [0.8,1.0)); INDETERMINATE iff (3 <= min d_s <= 5) OR (gamma_E in (0.6,0.8))"

The 3/5 min-d_s split and the gamma_E bands [0.5,0.6]/[0.8,1.0) are the two-sided pre-registered thresholds. d_s(sigma->0)=8 Weyl asymptotic (Minakshisundaram-Pleijel) is SETTLED and is the upper bound on the sigma->0 end ONLY (NOT the windowed observable)."

      Step 2: d_s(sigma) = -2 d ln P(sigma) / d ln sigma                          [definition; Weyl: d_s(sigma->0)->8]
      Step 3: gamma_E from N(lambda)-N(E_0) ~ sign(lambda-E_0)|lambda-E_0|^{1-gamma_E}  [cumulative-count DOS exponent at E_0=E_B2]
      Step 4 (DIRECTION read-off):
```
